summary: Review B (security) of Phase S3 at 0b6670d re-ran the block-selection attacks of the last three rounds with the repository checker. Commit 213407f closes F1 of b1d1530: each inner-start, trailing-start, nested, and end-before-start log with an invalid dispositions line now exits 1. No new fail-open bypass of the range rule was found. 4382 old logs in 19 project roots give no feedback, no exception, and no difference from the parser at b1d1530. The Red case (a line after the end line exits 0) agrees with contracts.md:122. Six nonblocking items are recorded. The most important item is a quadratic cost in the new block selection.
security_applicability_reason: test-strategy.md:173 says Review B is applicable for Phase S3 with full scope on the parser and its call. The phase diff a1a9396..0b6670d changes dispositions_feedback in skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py, and cmd_role_gate calls it for every role. Commit 213407f changes the block selection of this parser.
nonblocking_findings: skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:446-448 (dispositions_feedback, new in 213407f): 'any(start < index for start in starts)' runs once for each end line, so a log with all end lines before all start lines costs O(ends x starts). Direct calls took 0.320 s for 2000/2000 lines, 1.255 s for 5000/5000, 4.910 s for 10000/10000, and 19.103 s for 20000/20000 (about 1 MB of log). The gate result stays correct (fail-closed: the gate does not pass while it runs), and no old log is near this size. test-strategy.md:224 says that a run above 5 seconds is a finding. Recommendation: replace the test with 'starts and starts[0] < index', because the list is in ascending order. The parser at b1d1530 was linear for the same input.

tests/spec_review_gate/test_checker.py:497-501: the block-selection rule changed in 011b92c and in 213407f, and 'No file under tests/ changed' in either commit note. No test keeps the inner start line, the trailing start line, 'START / x / END / bad / END', the end line before the start line, or the second dispositions line in one block. Recommendation: add one DispositionsLineTest case for each of these five logs. Each must exit 1 with 'invalid dispositions line'.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:440-452 with :417 (unchanged class): when no exact line is a start line or an end line, or when a separator other than LF hides a line, the parser gives no feedback and has_agent_result still accepts the log by substring. Live 'role-gate --role strategy' probes gave exit 0 with 'dispositions: F1=BOGUS' for CR-only line endings, a UTF-8 BOM before the start line, a NUL after the start line, a start line inside another line, a U+200B before the end line, a Cyrillic letter in the start or the end line, and an end line without a start line. A new variant in a complete block also gave exit 0: 'role: x' plus U+2028, U+0085, VT, or CR, then 'dispositions: F1=BOGUS', on one LF line. A reader that uses str.splitlines() sees an invalid dispositions line in each log. The line is optional, so a role can also omit it, and the orchestrator checks each routed id. Recommendation: in the block range, split each LF line with str.splitlines() for the prefix scan. When no exact complete block exists, report each piece that starts with 'dispositions:' as 'dispositions line outside a complete result block'.

skills/measure-orchestrator/references/contracts.md:119: 'or after the first line of the log' excludes a start line on line 1, but the checker accepts a start line on line 1 (the docstring says 'after the top of the file'). The word 'previous' does not say previous to which line. The checker takes the last end line before the last start line that comes before the block end. Thus 'START / role: x / END / dispositions: F1=BOGUS / END' exits 1, which is stricter than a literal reading of the contract. Recommendation: write 'from the top of the log' and name the reference line of 'previous'.

Commit note of 213407f: 'A dispositions line after the last end line exits 1, per the new rule.' A live probe of 'START / role: x / END / dispositions: F1=BOGUS' gave exit 0, as contracts.md:122 and test_checker.py:500-501 require. The code is correct, and the note is wrong. Recommendation: correct the claim in the next Green note.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:83 and :643 (unchanged since the last round): DISPOSITIONS_ITEM_RE accepts U+2028, CR, and NUL in the CONTEST and ESCALATE text (live probe 'F1=CONTEST(a U+2028 b)', exit 0). A 'Dispositions:' line with a capital D, 'dispositions :' with a space, a fullwidth colon, and a Cyrillic 'o' in the prefix give no feedback. A folder as --log-file still reaches a read call and gives a traceback (fail-closed). Recommendation: reject Unicode categories Cc, Zl, and Zp in the text, and use Path.is_file() before the read.

Green result block in jr-green-s3-r6.log: 'dispositions: F1=FIX; F2=FIX; F3=CONTEST(...); F4=FIX'. F1 of that line is F1 of review-b-s3-b1d1530.json. F1 withdrawn: the four F1 logs of b1d1530 (inner start, inner start with fields, start-bad-start-end-end, start-end-bad-end) each gave exit 1 'FAIL: invalid dispositions line: F1=BOGUS' with 'role-gate --role strategy' in a temporary git repository.

Earlier attacks re-run (exit 1 for each): control invalid line, trailing start line, nested 'START / START / bad / END / END', two blocks with the second invalid, an end line before the start line, a second dispositions line, two valid dispositions lines, CRLF endings, an end line with trailing spaces and a tab, a start line with trailing spaces, a dispositions line with four leading spaces or a tab, a form feed or a NBSP before the end line. The control 'dispositions: F1=FIX; F2=CONTEST(x)' gave exit 0.

Contract-conformant exit 0: two blocks with the first invalid, and an invalid block followed by an empty block (last-block rule, contracts.md:118 and test_checker.py:497-498). A quoted block in a Markdown fence before the real block also uses the last block.

Red case confirmed: 'START / role: x / END / dispositions: F1=BOGUS' gave exit 0 'PASS: strategy gate passed'. The same log plus a trailing start line also gave exit 0. contracts.md:122 says 'A `dispositions:` line after the block end does not count.', and test_checker.py:500-501 asserts exit 0. The code, the test, and the contract agree.

Cost of the new selection (direct calls of dispositions_feedback): 1000000 start lines and one end line 0.554 s; 500000 complete empty blocks 0.574 s; one start line and 2000000 lines 0.448 s; 200000 dispositions lines 0.129 s; one 50 MB dispositions line 8.456 s (the item loop, not the selection); end lines before start lines 2000/2000 0.320 s, 5000/5000 1.255 s, 10000/10000 4.910 s, 20000/20000 19.103 s (nonblocking item 1).
